Нанесение [secondary]урона от стрельбы[/secondary] уменьшает [secondary]время восстановления[/secondary] [primary]"Древнего взрыва"[/primary].[newline][newline]Нажмите и удерживайте [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], чтобы досрочно прервать [primary]"Воплощение"[/primary] и частично ускорить [secondary]восстановление[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erzeugt eine [primary]Phasenexplosion[/primary], die Feinden in der Nähe [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] zufügt und ihre [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] vollständig wiederherstellt. Während sie aktiv ist, kann [primary]Vex[/primary] [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary] einsetzen und erhält erhöhte [secondary]Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit[/secondary].[newline][newline][primary]Schauriger Stoß:[/primary]Drücke [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], um einen [primary]Schaurigen Stoß[/primary] mit ihrer [secondary]Nebenhand[/secondary] abzufeuern, der bei Feinden in der Nähe beim Einschlag [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] verursacht. [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] zu verursachen, reduziert die [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary]-[secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary].[newline][newline]Halte [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] gedrückt, um [primary]Inkarnation[/primary] frühzeitig zu beenden, um teilweise [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] zurückzuerhalten.

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Restores [secondary]Repkit Cooldown[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]恢复[secondary]修复套件冷却时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства[/secondary]. [secondary]Время восстановления ремкомплекта[/secondary] уменьшается.
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Stellt [secondary]Reparaturkit-Abklingzeit[/secondary] wieder her.

desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden[/secondary] und [secondary]Schusswaffen-Handhabung[/secondary].

desc.EN: When [primary]Vex[/primary] uses a [secondary]Repkit[/secondary], she and her [primary]Minions[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Movement Speed[/secondary] and [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]使用[secondary]修复套件[/secondary]时，在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内提升自身及其[primary]仆从[/primary]的[secondary]移动速度[/secondary]和[secondary]射速[/secondary]。

[newline][newline][primary]Bleed[/primary] is affected by [secondary]Status Effect Application Chance[/secondary], and is itself considered a [secondary]Status Effect[/secondary].

desc.RU: [secondary]Критические попадания от стрельбы[/secondary] и [secondary]навыков[/secondary] могут наложить [primary]"Кровотечение"[/primary], вызывая [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]кинетический[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]временной стихийный урон[/kinetic] в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary]. desc.DE: [secondary]Kritische Treffer[/secondary] durch [secondary]Schusswaffen[/secondary] und [secondary]Skills[/secondary] haben eine Chance, [primary]Blutung[/primary] anzuwenden und so [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetik[/kinetic][/nowrap]-[kinetic]Statuseffekt-Zeitschaden[/kinetic] zu verursachen.[newline][newline][primary]Blutung[/primary] ist von [secondary]Statuseffekt-Anwendungschance[/secondary] beeinflusst und gilt selbst als [secondary]Statuseffekt[/secondary].

Stacks are lost when [primary]Incarnate[/primary] ends.
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]对附近敌人持续造成[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]，每影响一名敌人，都将获得[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]发动[primary]化身[/primary]时击杀敌人会获得一层[primary]能量吸血鬼[/primary]，提升[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]。[primary]化身[/primary]结束时失去叠加。

[newline][newline]Die Aktivierung von [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary] [secondary]verbraucht[/secondary] alle [secondary]Ladungen[/secondary], wobei jede [secondary]verbrauchte Ladung[/secondary] von getroffenen Feinden einmal [secondary]abprallt[/secondary].[newline][newline]Die [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary]-Reduktion von [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary] durch [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] [secondary]verdoppelt[/secondary] sich.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Vex[/primary] would enter [secondary]Fight For Your Life[/secondary], she immediately gets a [secondary]Second Wind[/secondary], becomes [secondary]Invisible[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary], and causes a [primary]Phase Explosion[/primary].
desc.ZH: 当[primary]维克丝[/primary]进入[secondary]殊死一搏[/secondary]时会立即获得[secondary]卷土重来[/secondary]并在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内[secondary]隐身[/secondary]，同时制造[primary]相位爆炸[/primary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Векс[/primary] входит в [secondary]режим борьбы за жизнь[/secondary], она немедленно получает [secondary]"Второе дыхание"[/secondary], на [secondary]время действия[/secondary] становится [secondary]невидимой[/secondary] и вызывает [primary]фазовый взрыв[/primary].
desc.DE: Wenn [primary]Vex[/primary] in [secondary]Kämpfe um dein Leben[/secondary] eintritt, erhält sie sofort [secondary]neue Stärke[/secondary], wird [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] [secondary]unsichtbar[/secondary] und verursacht eine [primary]Phasenexplosion[/primary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Maximum Health Capacity[/secondary] and [secondary]Health Regeneration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[secondary]最大生命值容量[/secondary]和[secondary]生命值恢复[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства[/secondary]. У [primary]Векс[/primary] повышается [secondary]максимальный уровень здоровья[/secondary] и [secondary]восстановление здоровья[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]maximale Gesundheitskapazität[/secondary] und [secondary]Gesundheitsregeneration[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Killing an enemy while [primary]Incarnate[/primary] is active will spawn a [primary]Soul Orb[/primary] that deals [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary] over time to nearby enemies for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].[newline][newline]Press [glyph]Action_Use[/glyph] at range to [secondary]detonate[/secondary] a [primary]Soul Orb[/primary], dealing [secondary]Ordnance Damage[/secondary] to nearby enemies.[newline][newline] Picking up a [primary]Soul Orb[/primary] will restore [secondary]Health[/secondary] and [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]发动[primary]化身[/primary]时击杀敌人将生成[primary]灵魂魔球[/primary]，在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内对附近敌人持续造成[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline]按[glyph]Action_Use[/glyph]远程[secondary]引爆[/secondary][primary]灵魂魔球[/primary]，对附近敌人造成[secondary]炮械伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline]拾取[primary]灵魂魔球[/primary]将恢复[secondary]生命值[/secondary]和[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Убийство врага во время активного [primary]"Воплощения"[/primary] вызывает появление [primary]сферы души[/primary], которая в течение [secondary]некоторого времени[/secondary] наносит [secondary]временной стихийный урон[/secondary] врагам поблизости.[newline][newline][primary]Сферу души[/primary] можно [secondary]сдетонировать[/secondary] на расстоянии, нажав [glyph]Action_Use[/glyph]. Она нанесет [secondary]урон от снарядов[/secondary] врагам поблизости.[newline][newline]Подобрав [primary]сферу души[/primary], можно восстановить [secondary]здоровье[/secondary] и [secondary]длительность активного навыка[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Einen Feind zu töten, während [primary]Inkarnation[/primary] aktiv ist, erzeugt eine [primary]Seelenkugel[/primary], die bei Feinden in der Nähe [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] [secondary]Statuseffekt-Zeitschaden[/secondary] verursacht.[newline][newline]Drücke [glyph]Action_Use[/glyph], wenn du in Reichweite bist, und lass eine [primary]Seelenkugel[/primary] [secondary]detonieren[/secondary], die bei Feinden in der Nähe [secondary]Kampfmittel-Schaden[/secondary] verursacht.[newline][newline] Das Aufnehmen einer [primary]Seelenkugel[/primary] stellt [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] und [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] wieder her.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Skill Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[secondary]技能伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от навыка[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] повышается.
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Action-Skill-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex's[/primary] [secondary]Kill Skills[/secondary] gain increased [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary][secondary]杀戮技能[/secondary]的[secondary]持续时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Время действия[/secondary] [secondary]навыка убийства[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] увеличено.
desc.DE: [primary]Vex'[/primary] [secondary]Kill-Skills[/secondary] erhalten eine erhöhte [secondary]Dauer[/secondary].

desc.EN: When [primary]Vex[/primary] uses a [secondary]Repkit[/secondary], her next [secondary]Gun Shot[/secondary] will become a [primary]Blood Shot[/primary], converting [secondary]Damage Dealt[/secondary] into [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetic[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic] Damage[/kinetic], and dealing [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] based on her [secondary]current Health[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]使用[secondary]修复套件[/secondary]时，其下一发[secondary]子弹[/secondary]将变为[primary]血腥弹药[/primary]，[secondary]造成的伤害[/secondary]将转化为[nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]动能[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]伤害[/kinetic]，并根据其[secondary]当前生命值[/secondary]造成[secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Когда [primary]Векс[/primary] использует [secondary]ремкомплект[/secondary], ее следующий [secondary]выстрел[/secondary] считается [primary]кровавым[/primary] и переводит [secondary]наносимый урон[/secondary] в [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]кинетический[/kinetic][/nowrap], а также наносит [secondary]дополнительный урон[/secondary], зависящий от [secondary]текущего уровня ее здоровья[/secondary].
desc.DE: Wenn [primary]Vex[/primary] ein [secondary]Reparaturkit[/secondary] benutzt, wird ihr nächster [secondary]Schuss[/secondary] zu einem [primary]Blutschuss[/primary], der den [secondary]verursachten Schaden[/secondary] in [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetikschaden[/kinetic][/nowrap] umwandelt und [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary] basierend auf ihrer [secondary]aktuellen Gesundheit[/secondary] verursacht.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains [secondary]Lifesteal[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Double[/secondary] this effect when an [secondary]Action Skill[/secondary] is active.
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]获得[secondary]吸血[/secondary]。[newline][newline]发动[secondary]主动技能[/secondary]时，此效果[secondary]加倍[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] получает [secondary]кражу здоровья[/secondary].[newline][newline]Эффект [secondary]удваивается[/secondary] при использовании [secondary]активного навыка[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Lebensraub[/secondary].[newline][newline]Dieser Effekt wird [secondary]verdoppelt[/secondary], wenn ein [secondary]Action-Skill[/secondary] aktiv ist.

desc.EN: [primary]Eldritch Blast[/primary] now [secondary]Sacrifices Health[/secondary] on use, but becomes a [secondary]Piercing wave[/secondary]. Enemies hit take [secondary]Damage[/secondary], and [secondary]Allies[/secondary] hit restore [secondary]Health[/secondary]. Gains [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Healing[/secondary] based on [secondary]Sacrificed Health[/secondary].[newline][newline] [primary]Eldritch Blast[/primary] no longer has a [secondary]Cooldown[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 现在使用[primary]奇异冲击波[/primary]时会[secondary]消耗生命值[/secondary]，但将变为[secondary]穿刺波[/secondary]。敌人被击中会受到[secondary]伤害[/secondary]，而[secondary]友方[/secondary]被击中则恢复[secondary]生命值[/secondary]。将根据[secondary]消耗的生命值[/secondary]，获得[secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]治疗[/secondary]。[newline][newline][primary]奇异冲击波[/primary]不再拥有[secondary]冷却时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]"Древний взрыв"[/primary] при использовании [secondary]тратит здоровье[/secondary], но превращается в [secondary]"пробивную волну"[/secondary]. Враги при попадании получают [secondary]урон[/secondary], а [secondary]союзники[/secondary] при попадании восстанавливают [secondary]здоровье[/secondary]. Увеличение [secondary]урона[/secondary] и [secondary]лечение[/secondary] зависят от количества [secondary]потраченного здоровья[/secondary].[newline][newline][primary]"Древний взрыв"[/primary] больше не требует [secondary]восстановления[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary] [secondary]opfert[/secondary] jetzt beim Einsatz [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary], wird jedoch zu einer [secondary]durchbohrenden Welle[/secondary]. Getroffene Feinde erleiden [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] und getroffene [secondary]Verbündete[/secondary] stellen [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] wieder her. Erhält [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary] und [secondary]Heilung[/secondary] basierend auf der [secondary]geopferten Gesundheit[/secondary].[newline][newline] [primary]Schauriger Stoß[/primary] hat keine [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] mehr.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains [secondary]Bonus[/secondary][nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetic[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]Damage[/kinetic] with [secondary]Guns[/secondary] based on her current [secondary]Lifesteal[/secondary] when her [secondary]Health[/secondary] is [secondary]full[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 当[primary]维克丝[/primary][secondary]生命值[/secondary][secondary]全满[/secondary]时，其[secondary]枪械[/secondary]会根据她当前的[secondary]吸血[/secondary]获得[secondary]加成[/secondary][nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]动能[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]伤害[/kinetic]。
desc.RU: При [secondary]полном[/secondary] [secondary]здоровье[/secondary] [secondary]пушки[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] наносят [secondary]дополнительный[/secondary] [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]кинетический[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]урон[/kinetic], значение которого зависит от ее текущего уровня [secondary]кражи здоровья[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex'[/primary] [secondary]Schusswaffen[/secondary] erhalten [secondary]Bonus-[/secondary] [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetikschaden[/kinetic][/nowrap] basierend auf ihrem aktuellen [secondary]Lebensraub[/secondary], wenn ihre [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] [secondary]voll[/secondary] ist.

desc.EN: [secondary]Charge Skill (3).[/secondary] [secondary]Spawn[/secondary] a [primary]Phase Clone Minion[/primary], choosing [primary]Specter[/primary] or [primary]Reaper[/primary]. [primary]Phase Clones[/primary] lose an ever-increasing amount of [secondary]Health[/secondary] per second, and their [secondary]Damage Type[/secondary] matches [primary]Vex's[/primary] current [primary]Attunement[/primary] when spawned.[newline][newline] Press [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Left[/glyph] to [secondary]Spawn[/secondary] a [primary]Reaper[/primary] that [secondary]Taunts[/secondary] enemies and deals [secondary]Melee Attack Damage[/secondary].[newline][newline]Press [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Right[/glyph] to [secondary]Spawn[/secondary] a [primary]Specter[/primary] that deals [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] and cannot move.
desc.ZH: [secondary]蓄能技能（3）。[/secondary][secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]相位克隆体仆从[/primary]，可选择[primary]幽灵[/primary]或[primary]死神[/primary]。[primary]相位克隆体[/primary]每秒损失的[secondary]生命值[/secondary]会持续增加，生成时的[secondary]伤害类型[/secondary]与[primary]维克丝的[/primary]当前[primary]调和[/primary]属性匹配。[newline][newline]按[glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Left[/glyph][secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]死神[/primary]，其会[secondary]嘲讽[/secondary]敌人并造成[secondary]近战攻击伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline]按[glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Right[/glyph][secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]幽灵[/primary]，其会造成[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]但无法移动。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык атаки (3)[/secondary]. [secondary]Появляется[/secondary] [primary]приспешник-фазовый клон[/primary] - [primary]призрак[/primary] или [primary]жнец[/primary]. [primary]Фазовые клоны[/primary] каждую секунду теряют все больше [secondary]здоровья[/secondary], а [secondary]наносимый урон[/secondary] будет соответствовать значению [primary]гармоничности[/primary] [primary]Векс[/primary] на момент появления. [newline][newline]Нажмите [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Left[/glyph], чтобы [secondary]создать[/secondary] [primary]жнеца[/primary], который [secondary]провоцирует[/secondary] врагов, нанося им [secondary]урон в ближнем бою[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Нажмите [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Right[/glyph], чтобы [secondary]создать[/secondary] [primary]призрака[/primary], который наносит врагам [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary], но не может перемещаться.
desc.DE: [secondary]Ladungs-Skill (3).[/secondary] [secondary]spawnt[/secondary] einen [primary]Phasenklon[/primary], entweder ein [primary]Phantom[/primary] oder einen [primary]Schnitter[/primary]. [primary]Phasenklone[/primary] verlieren eine sich ständig erhöhende Menge an [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] pro Sekunde und ihr [secondary]Schadenstyp[/secondary] richtet sich beim Einstieg nach [primary]Vex'[/primary] aktueller [primary]Einstimmung[/primary].[newline][newline] Drücke [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Left[/glyph], um einen [primary]Schnitter[/primary] zu [secondary]spawnen[/secondary], der Feinde [secondary]provoziert[/secondary] und [secondary]Nahkampf-Angriffsschaden[/secondary] verursacht.[newline][newline]Drücke [glyph]Action_ScreenButtons_Right[/glyph], um ein [primary]Phantom[/primary] zu [secondary]spawnen[/secondary], das [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] verursacht und sich nicht bewegen kann.

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] restore [secondary]Health[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary][primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]恢复[secondary]生命值[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешник(и)[/primary] восстанавливают [secondary]здоровье[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] stellt samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] wieder her.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain [secondary]Reload Speed[/secondary] based on the fullness of her [secondary]Health[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]根据她的[secondary]生命值[/secondary]百分比获得[secondary]装填速度[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Скорость перезарядки[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешника(ов)[/primary] повышается в зависимости от степени ее [secondary]здоровья[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]Nachladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary] basierend auf der Fülle ihrer [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].[newline][newline][primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain additional [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline][primary]仆从[/primary]获得额外[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] наносит повышенный [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary].[newline][newline]Ее [primary]приспешник(и)[/primary] наносят дополнительный [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].[newline][newline]Ebenfalls erhöhter [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] für [primary]Gefährten[/primary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Maximum Health Capacity[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]的[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]最大生命值容量[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешник(и)[/primary] наносят повышенный [secondary]урон в ближнем бою[/secondary], [secondary]максимальный запас их здоровья[/secondary] увеличивается.
desc.DE: Erhöhte [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] und [secondary]maximale Gesundheitskapazität[/secondary] für [primary]Vex[/primary] samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]的[secondary]射速[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] [secondary]Скорострельность[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешника(ов)[/primary] [secondary]временно[/secondary] повышается.
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] eine erhöhte [secondary]Feuerrate[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Minion Skill.[/primary] [primary]Specters[/primary] gain the ability to use [primary]Ghast Blast[/primary], dealing [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] to all nearby enemies on impact.[newline][newline][primary]Specters[/primary] will use [primary]Ghast Blast[/primary] on spawn, and after they [secondary]Reload[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]仆从技能。[/primary][primary]幽灵[/primary]获得使用[primary]恶灵冲击波[/primary]的能力，撞击附近所有敌人并造成[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline][primary]幽灵[/primary]在生成时和[secondary]装填[/secondary]后都会发动[primary]恶灵冲击波[/primary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык приспешника.[/primary] [primary]Призраки[/primary] получают возможность использовать [primary]"Взрыв с той стороны"[/primary], который при попадании наносит [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary] всем врагам поблизости.[newline][newline][primary]Призраки[/primary] используют [primary]"Взрыв с той стороны"[/primary] при появлении и после [secondary]перезарядки[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Gefährten-Skill.[/primary] [primary]Phantome[/primary] erhalten die Fähigkeit [primary]Ghast Blaster[/primary], die allen Feinden in der Nähe [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] bei Einschlag zufügt.[newline][newline][primary]Phantome[/primary] setzen [primary]Ghast Blaster[/primary] beim Spawnen und nach dem [secondary]Nachladen[/secondary] ein.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]的[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешник(и)[/primary] наносят повышенный [secondary]временной стихийный урон[/secondary].
desc.DE: Erhöhter [secondary]Statuseffekt-Schaden[/secondary] für [primary]Vex[/primary] samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Spawning[/secondary] a [primary]Reaper[/primary] grants [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minions[/primary] [secondary]Health Regeneration[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary]. [newline][newline][secondary]Spawning[/secondary] a [primary]Specter[/primary] grant [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minions[/primary] [secondary]Critical Hit Chance[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].[newline][newline]Both effects can stack.
desc.ZH: [secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]死神[/primary]时，[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内获得[secondary]生命值回复[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]幽灵[/primary]时，[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内获得[secondary]暴击率[/secondary]。[newline][newline]两种效果均可叠加。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [secondary]появляется[/secondary] [primary]жнец[/primary], [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешники[/primary] в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] [secondary]восстанавливают здоровье[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Каждый раз, когда [secondary]появляется[/secondary] [primary]призрак[/primary], [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешники[/primary] в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] получают [secondary]шанс критического попадания[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Оба эффекта суммируются.
desc.DE: Das [secondary]Spawnen[/secondary] eines [primary]Schnitters[/primary] gewährt [primary]Vex[/primary] und ihren [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] [secondary]Gesundheitsregeneration[/secondary].[newline][newline]Das [secondary]Spawnen[/secondary] eines [primary]Phantoms[/primary] gewährt [primary]Vex[/primary] und ihren [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] [secondary]kritische Trefferchance[/secondary].[newline][newline]Beide Effekte können gestapelt werden.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex's[/primary] [secondary]Melee Attacks[/secondary] apply [primary]Curse[/primary] to hit enemies, making them take [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetic[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]Status Effect Damage[/kinetic] any time they take [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Action Skill Cooldown Rate[/secondary].

desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Повышается [secondary]скорость восстановления активного навыка[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Action-Skill-Abklingzeit[/secondary].

desc.ZH: [primary]仆从[/primary]造成[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]将触发[primary]诅咒[/primary][secondary]伤害[/secondary]，如由[secondary]暴击[/secondary]触发，则会造成更高[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。

While [primary]Vex[/primary] is [primary]Attuned[/primary] to [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Corrosive[/corrosive][/nowrap], killing an enemy creates a [primary]Haunting Remnant Minion[/primary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary] that seeks out nearby enemies, dealing [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Corrosive[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]Status Effect Damage[/corrosive] over time. [newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Restore [primary]Haunting Remnant's[/primary] [secondary]Duration[/secondary], if active.
desc.ZH: [primary]调和杀戮技能[/primary]。当[primary]维克丝[/primary][primary]调和[/primary]至[nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]腐蚀[/corrosive][/nowrap]时，击杀敌人会生成[primary]侵扰骸灵仆从[/primary]，其将存在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]并会寻找附近敌人，持续造成[nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]腐蚀[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]状态效果伤害[/corrosive]。[newline][newline][secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]如[primary]侵扰骸灵[/primary]已存在，则恢复其[secondary]持续时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык убийства и гармоничности[/primary]. Когда [primary]Векс[/primary] [primary]настраивается[/primary] на [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]коррозию[/corrosive][/nowrap], убийство врага [secondary]на время действия[/secondary] создает [primary]привязанного приспешника-отзвук[/primary], который ищет врагов поблизости и наносит им [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]стихийный[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive] урон от коррозии[/corrosive] в течение некоторого времени. [newline][newline][secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Восстановите [secondary]время действия[/secondary] [primary]привязанного отзвука[/primary], если он активен.
desc.DE: [primary]Einstimmungs-Kill-Skill[/primary]. Während [primary]Vex[/primary] auf [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Korrosion[/corrosive][/nowrap] [primary]eingestimmt[/primary] ist, erzeugt das Töten eines Feindes [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] einen [primary]Spuküberbleibsel-Gefährten[/primary], der Feinde in der Nähe sucht und [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Korrosions[/corrosive][/nowrap]-[corrosive]Statuseffekt-Zeitschaden[/corrosive] verursacht. [newline][newline][secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Stellt die [secondary]Dauer[/secondary] von [primary]Spuküberbleibseln[/primary], wenn aktiv.

desc.EN: [primary]Minion Skill.[/primary] [primary]Specters[/primary] cast [primary]Wither[/primary] on an enemy when they [secondary]Spawn[/secondary], dealing [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary] over time, and increasing [secondary]Damage Taken[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].Can stack once per [secondary]Elemental Type[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Killing a [primary]Withered[/primary] enemy allows [primary]Specters[/primary] to use [primary]Wither[/primary] again.

desc.RU: [primary]Навык приспешника[/primary]. При [secondary]появлении[/secondary] [primary]призраки[/primary] поражают врага [primary]"Иссушением"[/primary], в течение некоторого времени нанося [secondary]временной стихийный урон[/secondary]. Также [secondary]временно[/secondary] повышается [secondary]получаемый урон[/secondary]. Каждый [secondary]тип стихии[/secondary] складывается один раз.[newline][newline][secondary]Навык убийства[/secondary]. Убийство [primary]иссушенного[/primary] врага позволяет [primary]призракам[/primary] снова использовать [primary]"Иссушение"[/primary].
desc.DE: [primary]Gefährten-Skill.[/primary] [primary]Phantome[/primary] wirken [primary]Verwelken[/primary] auf einen Feind, wenn sie [secondary]spawnen[/secondary], verursachen sie [secondary]Statuseffekt-Zeitschaden[/secondary] und erhöhen den [secondary]Schaden[/secondary], den sie [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] erleiden. Dieser Effekt kann einmal pro [secondary]Elementartyp[/secondary] gestapelt werden.[newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill. [/secondary] Durch das Töten eines [primary]verwelkten[/primary] Feindes können [primary]Phantome[/primary] [primary]Verwelken[/primary] erneut einsetzen.

desc.EN: [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary] gains a chance to [secondary]Critically Hit[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]有几率[secondary]暴击[/secondary]。

desc.DE: [secondary]Statuseffekt-Schaden[/secondary] erhält eine Chance auf [secondary]kritische Treffer[/secondary].

desc.EN: When [primary]Vex[/primary] swaps her current [secondary]Gun[/secondary], her new [secondary]Gun[/secondary] has its [secondary]Ammo[/secondary] partially [secondary]Refilled[/secondary].[newline][newline][flavor]"R-E-L-O-AYYOHH-D!"[/flavor]
desc.ZH: 当[primary]维克丝[/primary]切换当前[secondary]枪械[/secondary]时，会[secondary]补充[/secondary]其新[secondary]枪械[/secondary]的部分[secondary]弹药[/secondary]。[newline][newline][flavor]"装填万岁！"[/flavor]
desc.RU: Когда [primary]Векс[/primary] меняет [secondary]пушки[/secondary], запас [secondary]боеприпасов[/secondary] нового [secondary]оружия[/secondary] уже частично [secondary]восполнен[/secondary]. [newline][newline][flavor]"ПЕР-РЕЗАР-РЯДКА!"[/flavor]
desc.DE: Wenn [primary]Vex[/primary] ihre aktuelle [secondary]Waffe[/secondary] wechselt, wird die [secondary]Munition[/secondary] ihrer neuen [secondary]Schusswaffe[/secondary] teilweise [secondary]wiederaufgefüllt[/secondary].[newline][newline][flavor]"Nachladen war gestern!"[/flavor]

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Corrosive[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]Damage[/corrosive] and [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]Corrosive[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]Status Effect Damage[/corrosive].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]腐蚀[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]伤害[/corrosive]和[nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]腐蚀[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive]状态效果伤害[/corrosive]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] наносит повышенный [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]урон[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive] от коррозии[/corrosive] и [nowrap][corrosive_icon][corrosive]временной[/corrosive][/nowrap][corrosive] стихийный урон от коррозии[/corrosive].

desc.RU: На [secondary]время[/secondary] [primary]призраки[/primary] получают [secondary]копию[/secondary] [secondary]пушки[/secondary], в данный момент выбранной [primary]Векс[/primary].[newline][newline]Одновременно владеть [secondary]копией пушки[/secondary] может только один [primary]призрак[/primary], и появление нового [primary]призрака[/primary] отбирает [secondary]копию пушки[/secondary] у предыдущего.
desc.DE: [primary]Phantome[/primary] erhalten [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] eine [secondary]Kopie[/secondary] der aktuell ausgerüsteten [secondary]Schusswaffe[/secondary] von [primary]Vex[/primary]. Es kann nur jeweils ein [primary]Phantom[/primary] eine [secondary]kopierte Waffe[/secondary] haben. Der Einstieg eines neuen [primary]Phantoms[/primary] entfernt die [secondary]kopierte Waffe[/secondary] des vorherigen [primary]Phantoms[/primary].

desc.EN: [primary]Attunement Skill.[/primary]While [primary]Vex[/primary] is [primary]Attuned[/primary] to [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap], [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Critical Hit Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Status Effect Application Chance[/secondary].[newline][newline]These effects persist for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary] after [primary]Attunement[/primary] is switched.
desc.ZH: [primary]调和技能。[/primary]当[primary]维克丝[/primary][primary]调和[/primary]至[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap]时，提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]仆从[/primary]的[secondary]暴击伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]状态效果施加率[/secondary]。[newline][newline]切换[primary]调和[/primary]后此效果会持续[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык гармоничности.[/primary] Когда [primary]Векс[/primary] [primary]настраивается[/primary] на [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]огонь[/fire][/nowrap], у [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]приспешника(ов)[/primary] повышается [secondary]критический урон[/secondary] и [secondary]шанс наложения временного эффекта[/secondary].[newline][newline]Эффекты сохраняются в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] после смены [primary]гармоничности[/primary].
desc.DE: [primary]Einstimmungs-Skill.[/primary]Während [primary]Vex[/primary] auf [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brand[/fire][/nowrap] [primary]eingestimmt[/primary] ist, erhält [primary]Vex[/primary] samt [primary]Gefährten[/primary] [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden[/secondary] und eine [secondary]Anwendungschance für Statuseffekte[/secondary].[newline][newline]Diese Effekte dauern [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] nach dem Wechsel der [primary]Einstimmung[/primary] an.

desc.EN: [primary]Minion Skill[/primary]. [primary]Reapers[/primary] gain the ability to use [primary]Hellish Harvest[/primary], dealing [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] 3 times in a large area around themselves and [secondary]regenerate Health[/secondary] for each enemy hit.[newline][newline][primary]Reapers[/primary] will use [primary]Hellish Harvest[/primary] on spawn, and every [secondary]third time[/secondary] they [secondary]Melee Attack[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]仆从技能[/primary]。[primary]死神[/primary]获得使用[primary]地狱收割[/primary]的能力，在自身周围造成3次大范围[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]，每击中一名敌人都将[secondary]恢复生命值[/secondary]。[newline][newline][primary]死神[/primary]在生成时会发动[primary]地狱收割[/primary]，每[secondary]3次[/secondary][secondary]近战攻击[/secondary]时会再次发动。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык приспешника[/primary]. [primary]Жнецы[/primary] получают навык [primary]"Адская жатва":[/primary] наносят [secondary]урон в ближнем бою[/secondary] 3 раза на большой площади вокруг себя и [secondary]восстанавливают здоровье[/secondary] за каждое попадание по врагу.[newline][newline][primary]Жнецы[/primary] используют [primary]"Адскую жатву"[/primary] при появлении и на каждую [secondary]третью[/secondary] [secondary]атаку в ближнем бою[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Gefährten-Skill[/primary]. [primary]Schnitter[/primary] erhalten die Fähigkeit, [primary]Höllische Ernte[/primary] einzusetzen, um in einem großen Bereich um sich herum 3-mal [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] zu verursachen und für jeden getroffenen Feind [secondary]Gesundheit zu regenerieren[/secondary].[newline][newline][primary]Schnitter[/primary] setzen beim Einstieg und nach jedem [secondary]dritten[/secondary] [secondary]Nahkampfangriff[/secondary] [primary]Höllische Ernte[/primary] ein.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Vex[/primary] deals [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] or [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary], gain a Stack of [primary]Recurrence[/primary], which increases her and her [primary]Minions'[/primary] [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Stacks of [primary]Recurrence[/primary] are lost if a new Stack has not been gained for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 当[primary]维克丝[/primary]造成[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]或[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]时，会获得一层[primary]复发[/primary]，提升她及其[primary]仆从的[/primary][secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline]如[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内未获得新的叠加，则会失去[primary]复发[/primary]叠加层数。

[newline][newline]Если в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] не получать новый заряд, заряды [primary]"Цикличности"[/primary] пропадают.
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]Vex[/primary] [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] oder [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] verursacht, erhältst du einen Stapel [primary]Wiederkehr[/primary], der ihren [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] und [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] sowie den ihrer [primary]Gefährten[/primary] erhöht. [newline][newline][primary]Wiederkehr[/primary]-Stapel gehen verloren, wenn [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] kein neuer Stapel erhalten wurde.

desc.EN: [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] dealt by [primary]Vex[/primary] or her [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] has a chance to deal [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Melee Damage[/fire].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]或其[primary]仆从[/primary]造成的[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]有几率造成[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]近战伤害[/fire]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон в ближнем бою[/secondary], нанесенный [primary]Векс[/primary] или ее [primary]приспешником(ами)[/primary], имеет шанс стать [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]уроном[/fire][/nowrap][fire] в ближнем бою от огня[/fire].
desc.DE: Durch [primary]Vex[/primary] oder ihre(n) [primary]Gefährte(n)[/primary] verursachter [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] hat eine Chance, [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brand[/fire][/nowrap]-[fire]Nahkampfschaden[/fire] zu verursachen.

desc.EN: [secondary]Melee Override.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] now throws a [primary]Phase Dagger[/primary] from her [secondary]offhand[/secondary] that deals [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] to enemies hit. [primary]Phase Daggers[/primary] can [secondary]Critically Hit[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] [primary]Haruspex's[/primary] [secondary]Cooldown[/secondary] is [secondary]reset[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]近战替换。[/secondary][primary]维克丝[/primary]现在会用其[secondary]副手[/secondary]投掷一把[primary]相位匕首[/primary]，命中敌人时造成[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]。[primary]相位匕首[/primary]可以[secondary]暴击[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary][primary]占卜僧人的[/primary][secondary]冷却时间[/secondary]将[secondary]重置[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык ближнего боя[/secondary]. [secondary]Свободной рукой[/secondary] [primary]Векс[/primary] бросает [primary]фазовый клинок[/primary], который наносит [secondary]урон в ближнем бою[/secondary] врагам, в которых попадает. [primary]Фазовые клинки[/primary] могут давать [secondary]критические попадания[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] [secondary]Время восстановления[/secondary] [primary]"Гаруспика"[/primary] [secondary]обнуляется[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Nahkampf-Override.[/secondary] [primary]Vex[/primary] wirft jetzt einen [primary]Phasendolch[/primary] mit ihrer [secondary]Nebenhand[/secondary], der getroffenen Feinden [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] zufügt. [primary]Phasendolche[/primary] können [secondary]kritische Treffer[/secondary] sein.[newline][newline][secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Die [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] von [primary]Haruspex[/primary] wird [secondary]zurückgesetzt[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Damage[/fire] and [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Status Effect Damage[/fire].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]伤害[/fire]和[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]状态效果伤害[/fire]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] наносит повышенный [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]урон[/fire][/nowrap][fire] от огня[/fire] и [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]временной[/fire][/nowrap][fire] стихийный урон от огня[/fire].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brandschaden[/fire][/nowrap] und [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brand[/fire][/nowrap]-[fire]Statuseffekt-Schaden[/fire].

desc.EN: Press and hold [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]to spawn a [primary]Grim Reaper[/primary] that drains nearby enemies, dealing [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary] over time, and [secondary]regenerating Health[/secondary] for each drained enemy. [newline][newline]When an enemy dies while being drained, there is a [secondary]chance[/secondary] a new [primary]Reaper[/primary] will be spawned.
desc.ZH: 按住[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]将生成[primary]残忍死神[/primary]，其会吸取附近敌人，每吸取一名敌人都会持续造成[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]并[secondary]恢复生命值[/secondary]。[newline][newline]当敌人在被吸取时死亡，有[secondary]几率[/secondary]生成新的[primary]死神[/primary]。
desc.RU: Нажмите и удерживайте [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], чтобы вызвать [primary]Мрачного жнеца[/primary], который истощает врагов поблизости, нанося им [secondary]временной стихийный урон[/secondary] и [secondary]восстанавливая здоровье[/secondary] за каждого истощенного врага. [newline][newline]Когда враг под действием истощения умирает, [secondary]возможно[/secondary] появление нового [primary]жнеца[/primary].
desc.DE: Haltet [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] gedrückt, um einen [primary]Sensenmann[/primary] zu beschwören, der Feinden in der Nähe über Zeit [secondary]Statuseffekt-Schaden[/secondary] zufügt und für jeden ausgelaugten Feind [secondary]Gesundheit regeneriert[/secondary].[newline][newline]Wenn ein Feind stirbt, während er ausgelaugt wird, besteht eine [secondary]Chance[/secondary], dass ein neuer [primary]Schnitter[/primary] spawnt.

desc.EN: [primary]Haruspex[/primary] now throws [primary] 5 Phase Daggers[/primary] from [secondary]both hands[/secondary] in a [secondary]fan pattern[/secondary]. The [primary]Phase Daggers[/primary] deal [secondary]Reduced Damage[/secondary] and killing an enemy now [secondary]only refunds[/secondary] 33% of [primary]Haruspex's[/primary] [secondary]Cooldown[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]占卜僧人[/primary]现在会用[secondary]双手[/secondary]以[secondary]扇形[/secondary]范围投掷[primary]5把相位匕首[/primary]。[primary]相位匕首[/primary]造成的[secondary]伤害降低[/secondary]，击杀敌人时[secondary]仅返还[/secondary]33%的[primary]占卜僧人[/primary][secondary]冷却时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Гаруспик[/primary] теперь может бросать [primary]5 фазовых клинков[/primary] [secondary]конусом[/secondary] с [secondary]двух рук[/secondary].[primary]Фазовые клинки[/primary] наносят [secondary]пониженный урон[/secondary], а убийство врага теперь [secondary]восстанавливает[/secondary] 33% [secondary]времени восстановления[/secondary] [primary]"Гаруспика"[/primary].
desc.DE: [primary]Haruspex[/primary] wirft jetzt [primary]5 Phasendolche[/primary] mit [secondary]beiden Händen[/secondary] in einem [secondary]Fächermuster[/secondary]. Die [primary]Phasendolche[/primary] bewirken [secondary]reduzierten Schaden[/secondary] und einen Feind zu töten, [secondary]erstattet[/secondary] jetzt nur 33% der [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] von [primary]Haruspex[/primary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] and her [primary]Specters[/primary] deal [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] with [secondary]Gun Critical Hits[/secondary].[newline][newline]The [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] is a random [secondary]Elemental Type[/secondary] that changes on [secondary]Reload[/secondary]. [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] is further increased for each active [primary]Attunement Skill[/primary].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]及其[primary]幽灵[/primary]的[secondary]枪械暴击[/secondary]会造成[secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]为随机[secondary]元素类型[/secondary]，会在[secondary]装填[/secondary]时改变。每有一个活跃[primary]调和技能[/primary]，将进一步提升[secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] и ее [primary]призраки[/primary] наносят [secondary]дополнительный урон[/secondary] [secondary]критическими попаданиями при стрельбе[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Дополнительный урон[/secondary] имеет случайный [secondary]тип стихии[/secondary], который меняется при [secondary]перезарядке[/secondary]. [secondary]Дополнительный урон[/secondary] увеличивается за каждый активный [primary]навык гармоничности[/primary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] und ihre [primary]Phantome[/primary] verursachen [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary] mit [secondary]kritischen Schusswaffen-Treffern[/secondary].[newline][newline]Der [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary] ist ein zufälliger [secondary]Elementartyp[/secondary], der sich beim [secondary]Nachladen[/secondary] ändert. Für jeden aktiven [primary]Einstimmungs-Skill[/primary] wird der [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary]nochmals erhöht.

desc.EN: [primary]Minion Skill[/primary]. [primary]Reapers[/primary] can now use [primary]Banshee's Wail[/primary] periodically, dealing [secondary]Damage[/secondary] to nearby enemies and granting [secondary]Overshield[/secondary] to nearby [secondary]Allies[/secondary]. Damage increases apply to [secondary]Overshield[/secondary] granted to [secondary]Allies[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Damaged enemies deal reduced [secondary]Damage[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]仆从技能[/primary]。[primary]死神[/primary]现在可周期性使用[primary]女妖哀嚎[/primary]，对附近敌人造成[secondary]伤害[/secondary]，并向附近[secondary]友方[/secondary]提供[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]。[secondary]友方[/secondary]获得的[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]所受伤害提升。[newline][newline]在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内受伤敌人造成的[secondary]伤害[/secondary]降低。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык приспешника[/primary]. [primary]Жнецы[/primary] могут периодически использовать [primary]"Вопль банши"[/primary], нанося [secondary]урон[/secondary] врагам поблизости и накладывая на [secondary]союзников[/secondary] поблизости [secondary]суперщит[/secondary]. Увеличение урона применимо и к [secondary]суперщиту[/secondary], который получают [secondary]союзники[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Пораженные враги в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] наносят сниженный [secondary]урон[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Gefährten-Skill[/primary]. [primary]Schnitter[/primary] können jetzt wiederholt [primary]Todesfeen-Geheul[/primary] einsetzen, das Feinden in der Nähe [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] zufügt und [secondary]Verbündeten[/secondary] in der Nähe [secondary]Überschild[/secondary] gewährt. Schadenserhöhungen gelten auch für [secondary]Überschilde[/secondary], die [secondary]Verbündeten[/secondary] gewährt werden. [newline][newline]Verletzte Feinde verursachen [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] reduzierten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains increased [primary]Minion Damage[/primary].[newline][newline][primary]Minion Skills[/primary] and [primary]Command Skills[/primary] gain further increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]维克丝[/primary]的[primary]仆从伤害[/primary]。[newline][newline]同时进一步提升[primary]仆从技能[/primary]和[primary]命令技能[/primary]的[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Приспешники[/primary] [primary]Векс[/primary] наносят повышенный урон.[newline][newline][primary]Навыки приспешников[/primary] и [primary]навыки приказа[/primary] также наносят повышенный [secondary]урон[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält erhöhten [primary]Gefährtenschaden[/primary].[newline][newline][primary]Gefährten-Skills[/primary] und [primary]Kommando-Skills[/primary] erhalten noch höheren [secondary]Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Reapers[/primary] gain [secondary]Maximum Health Capacity[/secondary] and will release a [primary]Spirit Bomb Remnant[/primary] when they die, dealing [primary]Minion Damage[/primary] of their [secondary]Elemental Type[/secondary] to nearby enemies.
desc.ZH: [primary]死神[/primary]获得[secondary]最大生命值容量[/secondary]，并在死亡时释放[primary]灵魂炸弹骸灵[/primary]，对附近敌人造成与自身[secondary]元素类型[/secondary]相同的[primary]仆从伤害[/primary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Жнецы[/primary] получают [secondary]максимальный уровень здоровья[/secondary] и после смерти выпускают [primary]призрачную бомбу-отзвук[/primary], нанося [primary]урон приспешников[/primary] своего [secondary]типа стихии[/secondary] врагам поблизости.
desc.DE: [primary]Schnitter[/primary] erhalten [secondary]maximale Gesundheit[/secondary] und setzen bei ihrem Tod ein [primary]Geistbombe-Überbleibsel[/primary] frei, das Feinden in der Nähe [primary]Gefährtenschaden[/primary] ihres [secondary]Elementartyps[/secondary] zufügt.

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] gains a stack of [primary]Ancient Rites[/primary] for each of her active [primary]Minion(s)[/primary] every second, increasing [primary]Minion Damage[/primary]. [newline][newline]Stacks are lost after a [secondary]Duration[/secondary] with no active [primary]Minion[/primary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]每拥有一个活跃[primary]仆从[/primary]，每秒将获得一层[primary]古代仪式[/primary]，并提升[primary]仆从伤害[/primary]。[newline][newline]如[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内没有任何活跃[primary]仆从[/primary]，将在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]后失去叠加层数。
desc.RU: За каждого активного [primary]приспешника[/primary] [primary]Векс[/primary] каждую секунду получает заряд [primary]"Древних ритуалов"[/primary], который увеличивает [primary]урон от приспешников[/primary]. [newline][newline]Если в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] нет активных [primary]приспешников[/primary], заряды теряются.
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] erhält jede Sekunde einen Stapel [primary]Alte Riten[/primary] für jeden aktiven [primary]Gefährten[/primary], was den [secondary]Gefährtenschaden[/secondary] erhöht. [newline][newline]Stapel gehen nach einer [secondary]Dauer[/secondary] ohne aktive [primary]Gefährten[/primary][secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] verloren.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Vex[/primary] takes Damage while at [secondary]Low Health[/secondary], [secondary]Spawn[/secondary] a [primary]Reaper[/primary] nearby.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]维克丝[/primary]在[secondary]低生命值[/secondary]时受到伤害，将在附近[secondary]生成[/secondary][primary]死神[/primary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Векс[/primary] получает урон при [secondary]низком уровне здоровья[/secondary], поблизости [secondary]появляется[/secondary] [primary]жнец[/primary].
desc.DE: Wenn [primary]Vex[/primary] mit [secondary]niedriger Gesundheit[/secondary] Schaden nimmt, [secondary]spawnt[/secondary] sie einen [primary]Schnitter[/primary] in der Nähe.

desc.EN: [primary]Dead Ringer[/primary] gains an additional [secondary]Charge[/secondary].[newline][newline][flavor]"Bring out your Dead!"[/flavor]
desc.ZH: [primary]死亡分身[/primary]获得额外[secondary]使用次数[/secondary]。[newline][newline][flavor]"开门收尸！"[/flavor]
desc.RU: Дополнительный [secondary]заряд[/secondary] [primary]"Один к одному"[/primary].[newline][newline][flavor]"Выносите своих мертвецов!"[/flavor]
desc.DE: [primary]Todesbote[/primary] erhält eine zusätzliche [secondary]Ladung[/secondary].[newline][newline][flavor]"Raus mit den Toten!"[/flavor]

desc.EN: [primary]Vex[/primary] can now equip [primary]two Augments[/primary], and gains the ability to use [primary]Dark Pact[/primary].[newline][newline][primary]Dark Pact:[/primary] Press and hold [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] while a [primary]Minion[/primary] is active to fully [secondary]restore Health[/secondary] of all [primary]Phase Clones[/primary], as well as granting increased [secondary]Movement Speed[/secondary] and [primary]Minion Attack Speed[/primary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].[newline][newline] [primary]Phase Clones[/primary] do not lose [secondary]Health[/secondary] over time while [primary]Dark Pact[/primary] is active, and [secondary]Health[/secondary] loss is [secondary]reset[/secondary] when [primary]Dark Pact[/primary] ends.
desc.ZH: [primary]维克丝[/primary]现在可装备[primary]两个强化[/primary]，并获得使用[primary]黑暗契约[/primary]的能力。[newline][newline][primary]黑暗契约：在拥有活跃[primary]仆从[/primary]时，[/primary]按住[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]可使所有[primary]相位克隆体[/primary]完全[secondary]恢复生命值[/secondary]，并在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内提升其[secondary]移动速度[/secondary]和[primary]仆从攻击速度[/primary]。[newline][newline]发动[primary]黑暗契约[/primary]时，[primary]相位克隆体[/primary]不会持续损失[secondary]生命值[/secondary]，当[primary]黑暗契约[/primary]结束后[secondary]生命值[/secondary]损失将被[secondary]重置[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Векс[/primary] теперь может использовать [primary]два усиления[/primary] и получает возможность использовать [primary]"Темный договор"[/primary].[newline][newline][primary]"Темный договор":[/primary] пока активен [primary]приспешник[/primary], нажмите и удерживайте [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], чтобы полностью [secondary]восстановить здоровье[/secondary] всех [primary]фазовых клонов[/primary]. На [secondary]время действия[/secondary] они также получат увеличенную [secondary]скорость перемещения[/secondary] и [primary]скорость атаки приспешника[/primary].[newline][newline]Пока [primary]"Темный договор"[/primary] активен, [primary]фазовые клоны[/primary] не теряют [secondary]здоровья[/secondary], а по окончании действия [primary]"Темного договора"[/primary] потеря [secondary]здоровья[/secondary] [secondary]обнуляется[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Vex[/primary] kann nun [primary]zwei Erweiterungen[/primary] ausrüsten und erhält die Fähigkeit [primary]Dunkler Pakt[/primary].[newline][newline][primary]Dunkler Pakt:[/primary] Halte [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] gedrückt, während ein [primary]Gefährte[/primary] aktiv ist, um die [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] aller aktiven [primary]Phasenklone[/primary] vollständig [secondary]wiederherzustellen[/secondary] und [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] die [secondary]Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und die [primary]Gefährten-Angriffsgeschwindigkeit[/primary] zu erhöhen. [newline][newline] [primary]Phasenklone[/primary] verlieren keine [secondary]Gesundheit[/secondary] über Zeit, während [primary]Dunkler Pakt[/primary] aktiv ist, und der [secondary]Gesundheitsverlust[/secondary] wird [secondary]zurückgesetzt[/secondary], wenn [primary]Dunkler Pakt[/primary] endet.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Rafa[/primary] activates an [secondary]Action Skill[/secondary], he enters [primary]Overdrive[/primary]. While an [secondary]Action Skill[/secondary] is active, [primary]Overdrive's Duration[/primary] does not decrease.[newline][newline]While [primary]Overdrive[/primary] is active, [primary]Rafa[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Movement Speed[/secondary] and deals increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary] with all sources.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]拉法[/primary]发动[secondary]主动技能[/secondary]时，会进入[primary]超速过载[/primary]状态。[secondary]主动技能[/secondary]发动时，[primary]超速过载的持续时间[/primary]不会减少。[newline][newline]发动[primary]超速过载[/primary]时，提升[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]移动速度[/secondary]和造成的所有[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Рафа[/primary] задействует [secondary]активный навык[/secondary], он входит в режим [primary]форсажа[/primary]. Пока [secondary]активный навык[/secondary] действует, [primary]время действия форсажа[/primary] не идет.[newline][newline]Когда активен [primary]форсаж[/primary], повышается [secondary]скорость перемещения[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] и [secondary]урон[/secondary] всех видов.
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]Rafa[/primary] einen [secondary]Action-Skill[/secondary] aktiviert, verfällt er in [primary]Overdrive[/primary]. Bei aktivem [secondary]Action-Skill[/secondary] verringert sich die [primary]Overdrive[/primary]-Dauer nicht.[newline][newline]Bei aktivem [primary]Overdrive[/primary] erhält [primary]Rafa[/primary] erhöhte [secondary]Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und kann erhöhten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] jeder Art verursachen.

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa[/primary] equips shoulder mounted [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary], which fire at enemies in front of him for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary], dealing [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetic[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic] Gun Damage[/kinetic].[newline][newline]Press and Hold [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] to end [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] early, partially refunding [secondary]Action Skill Cooldown[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]拉法[/primary]装备肩扛式[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]，在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内向前方敌人射击，造成[nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]动能[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]枪械伤害[/kinetic]。[newline][newline]按住[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]可提前结束[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]，并返还部分[secondary]主动技能冷却时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Рафа[/primary] использует установленные на плечах [primary]"Пушки мироборца"[/primary], которые в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] стреляют во врагов перед ним, нанося [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]кинетический[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic] урон от стрельбы[/kinetic].[newline][newline]Нажатие и удержание [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] досрочно завершает действие [primary]"Пушек мироборца"[/primary], частично сокращая [secondary]время восстановления активного навыка[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Rafa[/primary] rüstet geschulterte [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] aus, die [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] auf Feinde vor ihm schießen und [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]kinetischen[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic] Schusswaffen-Schaden[/kinetic] verursachen. [newline][newline]Halte [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] gedrückt, um [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] vorzeitig zu beenden und einen Teil der [secondary]Aktion-Skill-Abklingzeit[/secondary] zurückzuerhalten.

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от стрельбы[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] увеличивается.
desc.DE: [primary]Rafa[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa[/primary] and his [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]拉法[/primary]及其[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]的[secondary]射速[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Скорострельность[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] и его [primary]пушек мироборца[/primary] повышается.
desc.DE: [primary]Rafa[/primary] und seine [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] erhalten eine erhöhte [secondary]Feuerrate[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Overdrive Skill[/primary]. [primary]Rafa[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Shield Recharge Rate[/secondary] and improved [secondary]Shield Regen Delay[/secondary] while [primary]Overdrive[/primary] is active.
desc.ZH: [primary]超速过载技能[/primary]。发动[primary]超速过载[/primary]时，提升[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]护盾充能速率[/secondary]并改善[secondary]护盾恢复延迟[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык форсажа[/primary]. Во время [primary]форсажа[/primary] у [primary]Рафы[/primary] увеличивается [secondary]скорость подзарядки щита[/secondary] и уменьшается [secondary]задержка подзарядки щита[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Overdrive-Skill[/primary]. [primary]Rafa[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Schild-Ladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und verbesserte [secondary]Schildregenerationsverzögerung[/secondary], während [primary]Overdrive[/primary] aktiv ist.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Rafa[/primary] [secondary]Critically Hits[/secondary] an enemy, [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] is restored.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]拉法[/primary]对敌人造成[secondary]暴击[/secondary]时，恢复[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Рафе[/primary] удается [secondary]критическое попадание[/secondary] во врага, продлевается [secondary]время действия его активного навыка[/secondary].
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]Rafa[/primary] einem Feind einen [secondary]kritischen Treffer[/secondary] zufügt, wird die [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] wiederhergestellt.

desc.EN: Rafa's [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Critical Hit Chance[/secondary].[newline][newline]Pressing [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] while [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] are active causes them to gain [secondary]Critical Hit Chance[/secondary] and [secondary]Critical Hit Damage[/secondary], while also causing his [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] to [secondary]drain faster[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Killing an enemy causes [primary]Rafa[/primary] to restore [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary], while also causing his [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] to [secondary]drain faster[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升拉法[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]的[secondary]暴击率[/secondary]。[newline][newline]在启用[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]时按[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]，火炮将获得[secondary]暴击率[/secondary]和[secondary]暴击伤害[/secondary]提升，同时会使他的[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary][secondary]消耗得更快[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]击杀敌人时，[primary]拉法[/primary]将恢复[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]，同时也会使他的[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary][secondary]消耗得更快[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]"Пушки мироборца"[/primary] Рафы получают повышенный [secondary]шанс критического попадания[/secondary].[newline][newline]При нажатии [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] во время действия [primary]"Пушек мироборца"[/primary] они получают [secondary]шанс критического попадания[/secondary] и [secondary]критического урона[/secondary], но [secondary]время действия активного навыка[/secondary] [secondary]расходуется быстрее[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] При убийстве врага [primary]Рафа[/primary] увеличивает [secondary]время действия активного навыка[/secondary], хотя [secondary]это время[/secondary] все равно [secondary]расходуется быстрее[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Rafas Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] erhalten eine erhöhte [secondary]kritische Trefferchance[/secondary].[newline][newline]Durch Drücken von [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] bei aktiven [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] erhöhen sich kurzzeitig ihre [secondary]kritische Trefferchance[/secondary] und ihr [secondary]kritischer Trefferschaden[/secondary], jedoch wird seine [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] schneller verbraucht.[newline][newline][secondary]Kill Skill. [/secondary]Einen Feind zu töten, stellt [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] wieder her, jedoch wird seine [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] schneller verbraucht.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Rafa[/primary] activates an [secondary]Action Skill[/secondary], he restores a portion of his [secondary]Maximum Shield Capacity[/secondary]. If his [secondary]Shields[/secondary] are already full, he gains [secondary]Overshield[/secondary] based on his [secondary]Maximum Shield Capacity[/secondary] instead.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]拉法[/primary]发动[secondary]主动技能[/secondary]时，其会恢复一部分[secondary]最大护盾容量[/secondary]。如其[secondary]护盾[/secondary]已全满，则根据自身[secondary]最大护盾容量[/secondary]获得[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Рафа[/primary] использует [secondary]активный навык[/secondary], часть [secondary]максимальной емкости его щита[/secondary] восстанавливается. Если его [secondary]щиты[/secondary] полностью заряжены, вместо этого активируется [secondary]суперщит[/secondary], емкость которого зависит от [secondary]максимальной емкости щита[/secondary].
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]Rafa[/primary] einen [secondary]Action-Skill[/secondary] aktiviert, wird ein Teil seiner [secondary]maximalen Schildkapazität[/secondary] wiederhergestellt. Wenn seine [secondary]Schilde[/secondary] bereits voll sind, erhält er stattdessen [secondary]Überschild[/secondary] basierend auf seiner [secondary]maximalen Schildkapazität[/secondary].

desc.EN: While [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] are active, [primary]Rafa[/primary] and his [secondary]Allies[/secondary] [secondary]Regenerate Ammo[/secondary] into their [secondary]Magazine[/secondary]. [primary]Rafa's Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] deal [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Bonus[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]Incendiary Damage[/fire] based on how full his [secondary]Gun[/secondary] is, and his [secondary]Turrets[/secondary] shoot [secondary]Exploding Bullets[/secondary] while his [secondary]Magazine[/secondary] is full.[newline][newline]Pressing [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] while [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] are active causes [primary]Rafa's[/primary] shots to  [secondary]consume no Ammo[/secondary], but causes his [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] to drain faster.
desc.ZH: 当启用[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]时，[primary]拉法[/primary]及其[secondary]友方[/secondary]的[secondary]弹匣[/secondary]会[secondary]恢复弹药[/secondary]。[primary]拉法的和平破坏者火炮[/primary]会根据其[secondary]枪械[/secondary]弹药量造成[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]加成[/fire][/nowrap][fire]燃烧伤害[/fire]，而当其[secondary]弹匣[/secondary]全满时，他的[secondary]炮塔[/secondary]会发射[secondary]爆炸子弹[/secondary]。[newline][newline]在启用[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]时按[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]，[primary]拉法的[/primary]射击将[secondary]不消耗弹药[/secondary]，但其[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]会消耗得更快。
desc.RU: Пока [primary]"Пушки мироборца"[/primary] активны, [primary]Рафа[/primary] и его [secondary]союзники[/secondary] [secondary]восстанавливают боеприпасы[/secondary] в [secondary]магазинах[/secondary]. [primary]"Пушки мироборца" Рафы[/primary] наносят [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]дополнительный[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]урон от огня[/fire], значение которого зависит от степени заряженности [secondary]пушки[/secondary], а его [secondary]турели[/secondary] стреляют [secondary]разрывными пулями[/secondary], когда [secondary]магазин[/secondary] полон.[newline][newline]Если нажать [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] при задействованных [primary]"Пушках мироборца"[/primary], выстрелы [primary]Рафы[/primary] [secondary]не будут тратить боеприпасы[/secondary], но [secondary]время действия активного навыка[/secondary] сократится.
desc.DE: Wenn [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] aktiv sind, regenerieren [primary]Rafa[/primary] und seine [secondary]Verbündeten[/secondary] [secondary]Munition[/secondary] in ihre [secondary]Magazine[/secondary]. [primary]Rafas Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] verursachen [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Bonus-[/fire][/nowrap][fire]Brandschaden[/fire], der davon abhängt, wie voll seine [secondary]Schusswaffe[/secondary] geladen ist, und seine [secondary]Geschütze[/secondary] verschießen [secondary]Explosionskugeln[/secondary], solange sein [secondary]Magazin[/secondary] voll ist.[newline][newline]Durch Drücken von [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], wenn [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] abgefeuert werden, verbrauchen [primary]Rafas[/primary] Schüsse für kurze Zeit [secondary]keine Munition[/secondary], verbrauchen jedoch seine [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] schneller.

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill[/secondary]. Killing an enemy restores [secondary]Shields[/secondary] based on [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Maximum Health Capacity[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]击杀敌人会根据[primary]拉法的[/primary][secondary]最大生命值容量[/secondary]恢复[secondary]护盾[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Убийство врага восстанавливает [secondary]заряд щита[/secondary] в зависимости от [secondary]максимального уровня здоровья[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Das Töten eines Feindes stellt [secondary]Schilde[/secondary] basierend auf [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]maximaler Gesundheitskapazität[/secondary] wieder her.

desc.EN: [primary]Overdrive Skill[/primary]. [primary]Rafa[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Damage Reduction[/secondary] while [primary]Overdrive[/primary] is active.
desc.ZH: [primary]超速过载技能[/primary]。发动[primary]超速过载[/primary]时，提升[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]伤害减免[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Навык форсажа[/primary]. Когда активен [primary]форсаж[/primary], [secondary]уменьшение урона[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] усиливается.
desc.DE: [primary]Overdrive-Skill[/primary]. [primary]Rafa[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Schadensreduktion[/secondary], während [primary]Overdrive[/primary] aktiv ist.

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Skill Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]技能伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от навыков[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] увеличен.
desc.DE: [primary]Rafa[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Skill-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Shields[/secondary] break after being fully recharged, spawn a free [secondary]Grenade[/secondary]. If he has a [secondary]Grenade[/secondary] equipped, use that [secondary]Grenade[/secondary] instead.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]拉法的[/primary][secondary]护盾[/secondary]在完全充能后破裂时，将生成免费[secondary]手雷[/secondary]。如其装备了[secondary]手雷[/secondary]，则生成该[secondary]手雷[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [secondary]щиты[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] пробиты после полной перезарядки, появляется бесплатная [secondary]граната[/secondary]. Если Рафа уже использует [secondary]гранату[/secondary], появляется соответствующая [secondary]граната[/secondary].
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Schilde[/secondary] nach vollständiger Aufladung brechen, spawnt eine kostenlose [secondary]Granate[/secondary]. Wenn er eine [secondary]Granate[/secondary] ausgerüstet hat, benutzt er stattdessen diese [secondary]Granate[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa[/primary] deals increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary] from all sources. The fuller [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Shields[/secondary] are, the greater the bonus. While [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Shields[/secondary] are at [secondary]Maximum Capacity[/secondary], [secondary]double the bonus[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]拉法[/primary]所有类型的[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。[primary]拉法[/primary]的[secondary]护盾值[/secondary]越高，加成越高。[primary]拉法[/primary][secondary]护盾[/secondary]处于[secondary]最大容量[/secondary]时，[secondary]加成加倍[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Рафа[/primary] наносит повышенный [secondary]урон[/secondary] из всех источников. Чем больше заряд [secondary]щита[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary], тем выше бонус. Когда [secondary]щиты[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] [secondary]полностью заряжены[/secondary], [secondary]бонус удваивается[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Rafa[/primary] verursacht erhöhten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] aus allen Quellen. Je voller [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Schilde[/secondary] sind, desto größer der Bonus. Während [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Schilde[/secondary] auf [secondary]maximaler Kapazität[/secondary] sind, [secondary]verdoppelt sich der Bonus[/secondary].

desc.EN: Pressing [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] while [primary]Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] are active causes them to fire two [secondary]Firebombs[/secondary] that deal [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]Damage[/fire] in a large area. Killing enemies partially [secondary]restores[/secondary] this [secondary]Skill's Cooldown[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 在启用[primary]和平破坏者火炮[/primary]时按[glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph]，其会发射2枚[secondary]火焰炸弹[/secondary]，造成大范围[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]伤害[/fire]。击杀敌人可[secondary]恢复[/secondary]部分此[secondary]技能冷却时间[/secondary]。
desc.RU: При задействованных [primary]"Пушках мироборца"[/primary] нажмите [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph], чтобы выпустить две [secondary]зажигательных бомбы[/secondary], наносящие [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]урон от огня[/fire][/nowrap] на большой площади. Убийство врага частично [secondary]сокращает время восстановления[/secondary] этого навыка.
desc.DE: Durch Drücken von [glyph]Action_Skill[/glyph] bei aktiven [primary]Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] werden zwei [secondary]Feuerbomben[/secondary] abgefeuert, die [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brandschaden[/fire][/nowrap] in einem großen Bereich verursachen. Feinde zu töten, [secondary]stellt[/secondary] die [secondary]Abklingzeit dieses Skills[/secondary] teilweise [secondary]wieder her[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Indirect Projectiles[/secondary] gain increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary]. [secondary]Indirect Projectiles[/secondary] include all [secondary]Action Skill Weapons[/secondary], [secondary]Thrown Guns[/secondary], and [secondary]Projectiles[/secondary] not fired from your [secondary]Gun[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]的[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。[secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]包括所有[secondary]主动技能武器[/secondary]、[secondary]投掷枪械[/secondary]和非[secondary]枪械[/secondary]发射的[secondary]射弹[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон[/secondary] от [secondary]ненаправленных снарядов[/secondary] повышен. [secondary]Ненаправленные снаряды[/secondary] включают в себя все [secondary]оружие от активных навыков[/secondary], [secondary]бросаемые пушки[/secondary] и [secondary]снаряды[/secondary], выпущенные не из вашей [secondary]пушки[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Indirekte Projektile[/secondary] verursachen erhöhten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary]. [secondary]Indirekte Projektile[/secondary] umfassen alle [secondary]Action-Skill-Waffen[/secondary], [secondary]geworfene Schusswaffen[/secondary] und [secondary]Projektile[/secondary], die nicht aus deiner [secondary]Schusswaffe[/secondary] abgefeuert werden.

desc.EN: All [secondary]Indirect Projectiles[/secondary] deal [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Bonus[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Incendiary Damage[/fire]. If the [secondary]Indirect Projectile[/secondary] already deals [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Damage[/fire], double the [secondary]Bonus[/secondary] Damage.
desc.ZH: 所有[secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]会造成[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]加成[/fire][/nowrap][fire]燃烧伤害[/fire]。如[secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]已造成[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]伤害[/fire]，则[secondary]加成[/secondary]伤害加倍。
desc.RU: Все [secondary]ненаправленные снаряды[/secondary] наносят [fire][nowrap][fire_icon]дополнительный урон от огня[/nowrap][/fire]. Если [secondary]эти снаряды[/secondary] уже наносят [nowrap][fire][fire_icon]урон от огня[/fire][/nowrap], [secondary]дополнительный[/secondary] урон удваивается.
desc.DE: Alle [secondary]indirekten Projektile[/secondary] verursachen [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Bonus[/fire][/nowrap]-[fire]Brandschaden[/fire]. Wenn das [secondary]indirekte Projektil[/secondary] bereits [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brandschaden[/fire][/nowrap] verursacht, verdoppelt sich der [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Indirect Projectiles[/secondary] gain [secondary]Lifesteal[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]拉法的[/primary][secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]获得[secondary]吸血[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Ненаправленные снаряды[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] могут [secondary]красть здоровье[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]indirekte Projektile[/secondary] erhalten [secondary]Lebensraub[/secondary].

desc.EN: While moving, shots have a [secondary]chance[/secondary] to [secondary]Ricochet off of[/secondary] [primary]Rafa[/primary]. This [secondary]chance[/secondary] is [secondary]doubled[/secondary] while [secondary]Sliding[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 移动时子弹有[secondary]几率[/secondary]从[primary]拉法[/primary]身上[secondary]跳弹[/secondary]。[secondary]滑铲[/secondary]时此[secondary]几率[/secondary][secondary]加倍[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Во время движения выстрелы получают [secondary]шанс[/secondary] [secondary]рикошетить[/secondary] от [primary]Рафы[/primary]. Во время [secondary]скольжения[/secondary] этот [secondary]шанс[/secondary] [secondary]удваивается[/secondary].
desc.DE: Während der Bewegung haben Schüsse eine [secondary]Chance[/secondary], von [primary]Rafa[/primary] [secondary]abzuprallen[/secondary]. Diese [secondary]Chance[/secondary] wird beim [secondary]Rutschen[/secondary] [secondary]verdoppelt[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Melee Override[/secondary]. Press [glyph]Action_Melee[/glyph] to lob a [primary]STRM Glider[/primary] at an enemy. Once it reaches its targets, it explodes and deals [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap][fire] Damage[/fire] in an area based on the amount of [secondary]Ammo[/secondary] in [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Gun[/secondary] when he threw the [primary]STRM Glider[/primary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]近战替换[/secondary]。按[glyph]Action_Melee[/glyph]，向敌人抛射一架[primary]暴风滑翔机[/primary]。其会在达到目标时自爆，并根据[primary]拉法[/primary]发射[primary]暴风滑翔机[/primary]时[secondary]枪械[/secondary]中的[secondary]弹药量[/secondary]造成范围[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]伤害[/fire]
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык ближнего боя[/secondary]. Нажмите [glyph]Action_Melee[/glyph], чтобы бросить во врага [primary]планер "ШТРМ"[/primary]. Долетев до цели, он взорвется и нанесет [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]урон[/fire][/nowrap][fire] от огня[/fire] по площади, значение которого зависит от количества [secondary]боеприпасов[/secondary] в [secondary]пушке[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] в момент броска [primary]планера "ШТРМ"[/primary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Nahkampf-Override[/secondary]. Halte [glyph]Action_Melee[/glyph] gedrückt, um einen [primary]STRM-Gleiter[/primary] auf einen Feind zu werfen. Sobald er sein Ziel erreicht, explodiert er und verursacht in einem Bereich [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brandschaden[/fire][/nowrap] basierend auf der [secondary]Munitionsmenge[/secondary] in [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Schusswaffe[/secondary] beim Werfen des [primary]STRM-Gleiters[/primary].

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa's Peacebreaker Cannons[/primary] are replaced with [secondary]Shotguns[/secondary] that deal increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary] and have an increased [secondary]Pellet Count[/secondary]. Additionally, [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Turrets[/secondary] gain a chance to [secondary]Ricochet[/secondary] off of targets. [secondary]Ricochets[/secondary] deal [secondary]Reduced Damage[/secondary], and [secondary]Critical Hits[/secondary] always [secondary]Ricochet[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]拉法的和平破坏者火炮[/primary]被替换为[secondary]霰弹枪[/secondary]，可造成更高[secondary]伤害[/secondary]并增加[secondary]弹丸数[/secondary]。此外，[primary]拉法的[/primary][secondary]炮塔[/secondary]有几率在目标身上[secondary]跳弹[/secondary]。[secondary]跳弹[/secondary]造成的[secondary]伤害降低[/secondary]，而[secondary]暴击[/secondary]必定[secondary]跳弹[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]"Пушки мироборца" Рафы[/primary] заменяются на [secondary]дробовики[/secondary], которые наносят повышенный [secondary]урон[/secondary] увеличенным [secondary]количеством дроби[/secondary]. Помимо этого, выстрелы [secondary]турелей[/secondary] [primary]Рафы[/primary] могут [secondary]рикошетить[/secondary] от целей. Урон от [secondary]рикошета[/secondary] [secondary]снижен[/secondary], но [secondary]критические попадания[/secondary] всегда [secondary]рикошетят[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]Rafas Friedensbrecher-Kanonen[/primary] werden durch [secondary]Shotguns[/secondary] ersetzt, die erhöhten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] verursachen und erhöhte [secondary]Kugelanzahl[/secondary] haben. Zusätzlich erhalten [primary]Rafas[/primary] [secondary]Geschütze[/secondary] eine Chance, von Zielen [secondary]abzuprallen[/secondary]. [secondary]Querschläger[/secondary] verursachen [secondary]reduzierten Schaden[/secondary] und [secondary]kritische Treffer[/secondary] [secondary]prallen immer ab[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]Rafa's[/primary] [secondary]Indirect Projectiles[/secondary] gain a chance to [secondary]Ricochet[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]拉法的[/primary][secondary]间接射弹[/secondary]有几率[secondary]跳弹[/secondary]。
