desc.EN: [primary]Cross-Fire's Dual Revolvers[/primary] are replaced with [primary]Dual Shotguns[/primary].[newline][newline] [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall:[/rd_color][/nowrap] Your [primary]Dual Shotguns[/primary] gain increased [secondary]Pellet Count[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]交叉火力的双持转轮手枪[/primary]被替换为[primary]双持霰弹枪[/primary]。[newline][newline][nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财：[/rd_color][/nowrap]增加[primary]双持霰弹枪[/primary]的[secondary]弹丸数量[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Двойные револьверы для перекрестного огня[/primary] заменяются на [primary]двойные дробовики[/primary].[newline][newline][nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везуха":[/rd_color][/nowrap] [secondary]количество дроби[/secondary] ваших [primary]двойных дробовиков[/primary] повышается.
desc.DE: Die [primary]Kreuzfeuer-Doppelrevolver[/primary] werden durch [primary]Doppelschrotflinten[/primary] ersetzt.[newline][newline] [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall:[/rd_color][/nowrap] Deine [primary]Doppelschrotflinten[/primary] erhalten mehr [secondary]Kugeln[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary] from all [secondary]sources[/secondary] for every [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap] [rd_color]Stack[/rd_color] he loses.
desc.ZH: [primary]老钱[/primary]每失去一层[nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap][rd_color]叠加[/rd_color]，都将提升其所有[secondary]类型[/secondary][secondary]伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон[/secondary] из всех [secondary]источников[/secondary] [primary]Н@ла[/primary] повышается за каждый потерянный [rd_color]заряд[/rd_color] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] aus allen [secondary]Quellen[/secondary] für jeden [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[rd_color]Stapel[/rd_color], den er verliert.

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Max Overshield[/secondary] and a portion of all [secondary]Damage[/secondary] [primary]C4SH[/primary] is dealt from [secondary]enemies[/secondary] is converted into [secondary]Overshield[/secondary].[newline][newline] Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] loses a [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap] [rd_color]Stack[/rd_color], shots from his [secondary]Guns[/secondary] deals [secondary]Bonus Damage[/secondary] equal to his [secondary]Overshield[/secondary] and drains a portion of his [secondary]Overshield[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]最大超强护盾[/secondary]，而[secondary]敌人[/secondary]对[primary]老钱[/primary]造成所有[secondary]伤害[/secondary]的一部分会转换为[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]。[newline][newline]当[primary]老钱[/primary]失去一层[nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap][rd_color]叠加[/rd_color]时，其[secondary]枪械[/secondary]的射击会造成[secondary]加成伤害[/secondary]，数值与其[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]相等，同时消耗其部分[secondary]超强护盾[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Н@л[/primary] получает [secondary]максимальный суперщит[/secondary], а часть всего [secondary]урона[/secondary], который [primary]Н@л[/primary] получает от [secondary]врагов[/secondary], добавляется к его [secondary]суперщиту[/secondary].[newline][newline] Каждый раз, когда [primary]Н@л[/primary] теряет [rd_color]заряд[/rd_color] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap], выстрелы из его [secondary]пушек[/secondary] наносят [secondary]дополнительный урон[/secondary], равный объему его [secondary]суперщита[/secondary], и похищают его часть.
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]maximalen Überschild[/secondary] und ein Teil des gesamten [secondary]Schadens[/secondary], den [primary]C4SH[/primary] durch [secondary]Feinde[/secondary] erleidet, wird in [secondary]Überschild[/secondary] verwandelt.[newline][newline] Immer wenn [primary]C4SH[/primary] einen [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[rd_color]Stapel[/rd_color] verliert, verursachen Schüsse aus seinen [secondary]Schusswaffen[/secondary] [secondary]Bonusschaden[/secondary] in Höhe seines [secondary]Überschilds[/secondary] und leeren einen Teil seines [secondary]Überschilds[/secondary].

desc.EN: As [primary]C4SH[/primary] slides he loses [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap] [rd_color]Stacks[/rd_color]. For every [secondary]Stack[/secondary] he loses, he gains increased [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary], [secondary]Reload Speed[/secondary], and [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [primary]老钱[/primary]在滑铲时，其将失去[nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap][rd_color]叠加[/rd_color]。每失去一层[secondary]叠加[/secondary]，都将提升其[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]、[secondary]装填速度[/secondary]和[secondary]射速[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Пока [primary]Н@л[/primary] скользит, он теряет [rd_color]заряды[/rd_color] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap]. За каждый потерянный [secondary]заряд[/secondary] его [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary], [secondary]скорость перезарядки[/secondary] и [secondary]скорострельность[/secondary] повышаются.
desc.DE: Beim Rutschen verliert [primary]C4SH[/primary] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[rd_color]Stapel[/rd_color]. Für jeden verlorenen [secondary]Stapel[/secondary] erhält er erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary], erhöhte [secondary]Nachladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und erhöhte [secondary]Feuerrate[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] kills an [secondary]enemy[/secondary] during [primary]Cross-Fire[/primary], [secondary]enemies[/secondary] have a [secondary]Chance[/secondary] to drop [primary]Bone Dice[/primary] that [secondary]spawn[/secondary] a random [primary]Cleromancy Bone Totem[/primary]. This Skill has a [secondary]Cooldown[/secondary] and only two [primary]Bone Totems[/primary] may be active at a time.
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能[/secondary]。当[primary]老钱[/primary]在[primary]交叉火力[/primary]期间击杀[secondary]敌人[/secondary]时，[secondary]敌人[/secondary]有几率掉落[primary]骸骨骰子[/primary]，可[secondary]触发[/secondary][primary]掷骰占卜随机生成骸骨图腾[/primary]。此技能拥有[secondary]冷却时间[/secondary]，并且一次只能激活两个[primary]骸骨图腾[/primary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Каждый раз, когда [primary]Н@л[/primary] убивает [secondary]врага[/secondary] во время действия [primary]"Перекрестного огня"[/primary], из [secondary]врага[/secondary] [secondary]может[/secondary] выпасть [primary]костяной кубик[/primary], который [secondary]вызывает[/secondary] случайный [primary]костяной гадательный тотем[/primary]. У этого навыка есть [secondary]время восстановления[/secondary]. Одновременно могут быть активны только два [primary]костяных тотема[/primary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Immer wenn [primary]C4SH[/primary] während [primary]Kreuzfeuer[/primary] einen [secondary]Feind[/secondary] tötet, haben [secondary]Feinde[/secondary] eine [secondary]Chance[/secondary], [primary]Knochenwürfel[/primary] fallen zu lassen, die ein zufälliges [primary]Kleromantie-Knochen-Totem[/primary] [secondary]spawnen[/secondary]. Dieser Skill hat eine [secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] und es können immer nur zwei [primary]Knochen-Totems[/primary] gleichzeitig aktiv sein.

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] activates [primary]Cross-Fire's[/primary] [secondary]Burst Fire[/secondary], he gains a [secondary]Chance[/secondary] to enter [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap].[newline][newline] Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] attempts to enter [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] and fails, he resets his [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] and it drains faster.
desc.ZH: 当[primary]老钱[/primary]发动[primary]交叉火力[/primary]的[secondary]连发[/secondary]时，其有[secondary]几率[/secondary]进入[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]状态。[newline][newline]当[primary]老钱[/primary]尝试进入[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]状态并失败时，其[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]会重置且消耗得更快。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]Н@л[/primary] активирует [secondary]"Очередь"[/secondary] в режиме [primary]перекрестного огня[/primary], он получает [secondary]шанс[/secondary] войти в режим [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везухи"[/rd_color][/nowrap].[newline][newline] Каждый раз, когда [primary]Н@л[/primary] пытается войти в режим [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везухи"[/rd_color][/nowrap] и ему это не удается, он заново начинает отсчет [secondary]длительности активного навыка[/secondary], но время идет быстрее.
desc.DE: Immer wenn [primary]C4SH[/primary] den [secondary]Feuerstoß[/secondary] von [primary]Kreuzfeuer[/primary] aktiviert, erhält er eine [secondary]Chance[/secondary], [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] auszulösen.[newline][newline] Wenn [primary]C4SH[/primary] beim Auslösen von [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] scheitert, setzt er seine [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary] zurück und verbraucht sie schneller.

desc.EN: [secondary]Charge Skill (4).[/secondary] [primary]C4SH[/primary] draws a [primary]Card[/primary] in each hand. Pressing [glyph]Action_Fire[/glyph]/[glyph]Action_Zoom[/glyph] throws a [primary]Card[/primary] to targets under his [secondary]crosshairs[/secondary]. Each [primary]Card[/primary] is [secondary]Randomly Drawn[/secondary] and each have different effects. While [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] is active, [primary]Cards[/primary] have greatly increased [secondary]effects[/secondary]. [primary]Sleight of Hand[/primary] gains additional [secondary]Action Skill Duration[/secondary] based on additional [secondary]Charges[/secondary], and each unused [secondary]Charge[/secondary] restores of a portion of [primary]Sleight of Hand[/primary] [secondary]Cooldown[/secondary]. [newline][newline] [primary]Fireball:[/primary] [primary]Card[/primary] creates an [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]Nova[/fire] when it detonates. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] creates a [secondary]Rupture[/secondary], constantly spewing [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Incendiary[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]Mortars[/fire].[newline][newline] [primary]Magic Missile:[/primary] [primary]Card[/primary] splits as it travels, homing in on [secondary]enemies[/secondary] and dealing [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetic[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]Damage[/kinetic]. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] causes the [primary]Card[/primary] to [secondary]double[/secondary] the amount it splits.
desc.ZH: [secondary]蓄能技能（4）[/secondary]。[primary]老钱[/primary]每只手各抽一张[primary]卡牌[/primary]。按[glyph]Action_Fire[/glyph]/[glyph]Action_Zoom[/glyph]会向其[secondary]准心[/secondary]位置的目标扔出一张[primary]卡牌[/primary]。每张[primary]卡牌[/primary]将被[secondary]随机抽出[/secondary]，且各自拥有不同效果。发动[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]时，将大幅提升[primary]卡牌[/primary][secondary]效果[/secondary]。[primary]手上功夫[/primary]会根据额外[secondary]能量点[/secondary]获得额外[secondary]主动技能持续时间[/secondary]，并且每点未使用的[secondary]能量点[/secondary]都会恢复[primary]手上功夫[/primary]的部分[secondary]冷却时间[/secondary]。[newline][newline][primary]火球：[/primary][primary]卡牌[/primary]爆炸时会生成[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]星爆[/fire]。[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]会生成[secondary]破裂[/secondary]，不断喷出[nowrap][fire_icon][fire]燃烧[/fire][/nowrap][fire]迫击炮[/fire]。[newline][newline][primary]魔法导弹：[/primary][primary]卡牌[/primary]会在飞行时分裂，自动追踪[secondary]敌人[/secondary]并造成[nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]动能[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]伤害[/kinetic]。[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]会使[primary]卡牌[/primary]的分裂数量[secondary]加倍[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык зарядки (4).[/secondary] [primary]Н@л[/primary] берет по [primary]карте[/primary] в каждую руку. При нажатии [glyph]Action_Fire[/glyph]/[glyph]Action_Zoom[/glyph] он бросает [primary]карту[/primary] под [secondary]прицел[/secondary]. Каждая [primary]карта[/primary] [secondary]вытаскивается случайным образом[/secondary] и имеет разные эффекты. Пока активна [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везуха"[/rd_color][/nowrap], [secondary]эффекты[/secondary] [primary]карт[/primary] значительно усилены. [primary]"Ловкость рук"[/primary] дополнительно увеличивает [secondary]длительность активного навыка[/secondary] в зависимости от дополнительных [secondary]зарядов[/secondary], а каждый неиспользованный [secondary]заряд[/secondary] частично сокращает [secondary]восстановление[/secondary] [primary]"Ловкости рук"[/primary].[newline][newline] [primary]Огненный шар:[/primary] при детонации [primary]карта[/primary] создает [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]огненную[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]волну[/fire]. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везуха"[/rd_color][/nowrap] создает [secondary]разлом[/secondary], постоянно изрыгающий [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]огненные[/fire][/nowrap] [fire]мины[/fire].[newline][newline] [primary]Волшебный снаряд:[/primary] в полете [primary]карта[/primary] разделяется, наводится на [secondary]врагов[/secondary] и наносит [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]кинетический[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]урон[/kinetic]. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везуха"[/rd_color][/nowrap] увеличивает число разделений [primary]карты[/primary] [secondary]вдвое[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Ladungs-Skill (4).[/secondary] [primary]C4SH[/primary] zieht eine [primary]Karte[/primary] mit jeder Hand. Wenn du [glyph]Action_Fire[/glyph]/[glyph]Action_Zoom[/glyph] drückst, wirft er eine [primary]Karte[/primary] auf Ziele in seinem [secondary]Fadenkreuz[/secondary]. Jede [primary]Karte[/primary] wird [secondary]zufällig gezogen[/secondary] und hat jeweils eigene Effekte. Wenn [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] aktiv ist, haben [primary]Karten[/primary] deutlich stärkere [secondary]Effekte[/secondary]. [primary]Fingerfertigkeit[/primary] erhält zusätzliche [secondary]Action-Skill-Dauer[/secondary], basierend auf zusätzlichen [secondary]Ladungen[/secondary], und jede nicht verbrauchte [secondary]Ladung[/secondary] stellt einen Teil der [primary]Fingerfertigkeit[/primary]-[secondary]Abklingzeit[/secondary] wieder her. [newline][newline] [primary]Feuerball:[/primary] Die [primary]Karte[/primary] spawnt eine [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brand[/fire][/nowrap]-[fire]Nova[/fire], wenn sie detoniert. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] spawnt einen [secondary]Riss[/secondary], der ständig [nowrap][fire_icon][fire]Brandmörser[/fire][/nowrap] ausspuckt.[newline][newline] [primary]Magische Rakete:[/primary] Die [primary]Karte[/primary] teilt sich während des Fluges, fliegt auf [secondary]Feinde[/secondary] zu und verursacht [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Kinetikschaden[/kinetic][/nowrap]. [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] bewirkt, dass sich die [primary]Karte[/primary] [secondary]doppelt[/secondary] so oft teilt.

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Reload Speed[/secondary].[newline][newline] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap] [rd_color]Stacks[/rd_color] gain increased [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] [rd_color]Chance[/rd_color].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]装填速度[/secondary]。[newline][newline]提升[nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap][rd_color]叠加[/rd_color]的[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap][rd_color]几率[/rd_color]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Скорость перезарядки[/secondary] [primary]Н@ла[/primary] повышается.[newline][newline] У [rd_color]зарядов[/rd_color] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap] повышается [rd_color]шанс[/rd_color] активации [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везухи"[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält eine erhöhte [secondary]Nachladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary].[newline][newline] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[rd_color]Stapel[/rd_color] erhalten eine erhöhte [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[rd_color]Chance[/rd_color].

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Shield Capacity[/secondary], [secondary]Shield Recharge Rate[/secondary], and improved [secondary]Shield Recharge Delay[/secondary].[newline][newline] Whenever [primary]C4SH's[/primary] [secondary]Shield[/secondary] fully recharges, he gains a [secondary]Stack[/secondary] of [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]护盾容量[/secondary]、[secondary]护盾充能速率[/secondary]，并改善[secondary]护盾充能延迟[/secondary]。[newline][newline]当[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]护盾[/secondary]完全充能时，其会获得一[secondary]层[/secondary][nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap]。
desc.RU: У [primary]Н@ла[/primary] повышается [secondary]емкость щита[/secondary] и [secondary]скорость подзарядки щита[/secondary] и уменьшается [secondary]задержка подзарядки щита[/secondary].[newline][newline] Каждый раз, когда [secondary]щит[/secondary] [primary]Н@ла[/primary] полностью заряжается, он получает [secondary]заряд[/secondary] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Schildkapazität[/secondary], [secondary]Schild-Ladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary] sowie verbesserte [secondary]Schild-Ladeverzögerung[/secondary].[newline][newline] Immer wenn [primary]C4SHs[/primary] [secondary]Schild[/secondary] voll aufgeladen ist, erhält er einen [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[secondary]Stapel[/secondary].

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Ordnance Damage[/secondary]. This bonus is [secondary]doubled[/secondary] while [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Windfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] is active.
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]炮械伤害[/secondary]。发动[nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]意外之财[/rd_color][/nowrap]时，此加成效果[secondary]加倍[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от снарядов[/secondary] [primary]Н@ла[/primary] повышен. Пока активна [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]"Везуха"[/rd_color][/nowrap], этот бонус [secondary]удваивается[/secondary].
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Kampfmittel-Schaden[/secondary]. Dieser Bonus wird [secondary]verdoppelt[/secondary], wenn [nowrap][wfll_icon][rd_color]Glücksfall[/rd_color][/nowrap] aktiv ist.

desc.EN: [primary]C4SH[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Elemental Effect Chance[/secondary].[newline][newline] Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] applies an [secondary]Elemental Effect[/secondary] he gains a [secondary]Stack[/secondary] of [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]老钱[/primary]的[secondary]元素效果率[/secondary]。[newline][newline]当[primary]老钱[/primary]施加[secondary]元素效果[/secondary]时，其会获得一[secondary]层[/secondary][nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转[/rd_color][/nowrap]。
desc.RU: [primary]Н@л[/primary] получает повышенный [secondary]шанс стихийного урона[/secondary].[newline][newline] Каждый раз, когда [primary]Н@л[/primary] накладывает [secondary]стихийный эффект[/secondary], он получает [secondary]заряд[/secondary] [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]удачи[/rd_color][/nowrap].
desc.DE: [primary]C4SH[/primary] erhält eine erhöhte [secondary]Elementareffekt-Chance[/secondary].[newline][newline] Immer wenn [primary]C4SH[/primary] einen [secondary]Elementareffekt[/secondary] anwendet, erhält er einen [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Glückssträhne[/rd_color][/nowrap]-[secondary]Stapel[/secondary].

desc.EN: Whenever [primary]C4SH[/primary] would gain a [nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]Fortune Stack[/rd_color][/nowrap], he gains a [secondary]Chance[/secondary] to gain [secondary]additional Stacks[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 当[primary]老钱[/primary]获得一层[nowrap][frtn_icon][rd_color]时来运转叠加[/rd_color][/nowrap]时，其有[secondary]几率[/secondary]获得[secondary]额外叠加[/secondary]。

desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]炮械冷却速率[/secondary]。

desc.EN: [secondary]Ordnance[/secondary] gains a chance to [secondary]Critically Hit[/secondary] enemies, and also gains increased [secondary]Ordnance Critical Hit Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]炮械[/secondary]有几率[secondary]暴击[/secondary]敌人，同时提升[secondary]炮械暴击伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Снаряды[/secondary] дают шанс [secondary]критического попадания[/secondary] по врагу. [secondary]Критический урон от снарядов[/secondary] повышен.
desc.DE: [secondary]Kampfmittel[/secondary] erhalten eine Chance, Feinde [secondary]kritisch zu treffen[/secondary], und erhöhten [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden für Kampfmittel[/secondary].

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。

desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: When entering [secondary]Fight For Your Life[/secondary], all [secondary]Guns[/secondary] are automatically [secondary]Reloaded[/secondary], and the [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 进入[secondary]殊死一搏[/secondary]状态时，自动[secondary]装填[/secondary]所有[secondary]枪械[/secondary]并提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]射速[/secondary]。
desc.RU: При входе в [secondary]режим борьбы за жизнь[/secondary] все [secondary]пушки[/secondary] автоматически [secondary]перезаряжаются[/secondary], а [secondary]скорострельность[/secondary] [primary]искателя Хранилища[/primary] увеличивается.
desc.DE: Beim Eintritt in [secondary]Kämpfe um dein Leben[/secondary], werden alle [secondary]Schusswaffen[/secondary] automatisch [secondary]nachgeladen[/secondary] und der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Feuerrate[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] grants the [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] increased [secondary]Fire Rate[/secondary] for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]在[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]射速[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон в ближнем бою[/secondary] на [secondary]время действия[/secondary] увеличивает [secondary]скорострельность[/secondary] [primary]искателя Хранилища[/primary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] gewährt dem [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] [secondary]vorübergehend[/secondary] erhöhte [secondary]Feuerrate[/secondary].

desc.EN: Whenever the [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] deals [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary], gain a Stack of  [primary]Riddle You This[/primary], increasing [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Stacks are lost if a new Stack has not been gained for a [secondary]Duration[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 当[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]造成[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]时会获得一层[primary]让我考考你[/primary]，提升该[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline]如[secondary]一段时间[/secondary]内未获得新的叠加，则会失去所有叠加层数。
desc.RU: Каждый раз, когда [primary]искатель Хранилища[/primary] наносит [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary], то получает заряд эффекта [primary]"Отгадай загадку"[/primary], который повышает [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary]. [newline][newline]Если в течение [secondary]времени действия[/secondary] не набираются новые заряды, все заряды исчезают.
desc.DE: Immer wenn der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] verursacht, erhältst du einen Stapel [primary]Ein Rätsel für dich[/primary] und somit erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].[newline][newline]Die Stapel gehen verloren, wenn nach einer gewissen [secondary]Dauer[/secondary] kein neuer Stapel erhalten wurde.

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Critical Hit Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Status Effect Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]暴击伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]状态效果伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Искатель Хранилища[/primary] наносит повышенный [secondary]критический урон[/secondary] и [secondary]временной стихийный урон[/secondary].
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält erhöhten [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden[/secondary] und [secondary]Statuseffekt-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Critical Hits[/secondary] grant increased [secondary]Status Effect Application Chance[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]暴击[/secondary]将提升[secondary]状态效果施加率[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Критические попадания[/secondary] повышают [secondary]шанс наложения временного стихийного эффекта[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kritische Treffer[/secondary] gewähren erhöhte [secondary]Statuseffekt-Anwendungschance[/secondary].

desc.EN: Enemies take increased [secondary]Damage[/secondary] for each [secondary]Status Effect[/secondary] applied to them.
desc.ZH: 对敌人施加的每个[secondary]状态效果[/secondary]将提升其所受[secondary]伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: Враги получают увеличенный [secondary]урон[/secondary] от каждого [secondary]временного стихийного эффекта[/secondary], наложенного на них.
desc.DE: Feinde erleiden zusätzlichen [secondary]Schaden für jeden [/secondary]Statuseffekt, der auf ihnen lastet.

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Killing an enemy with a [secondary]Critical Hit[/secondary] will cause them to explode, dealing [secondary]Skill Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]敌人被[secondary]暴击[/secondary]击杀后会爆炸，造成[secondary]技能伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Убийство [secondary]критическим попаданием[/secondary] сопровождается взрывом цели и наносит [secondary]урон от навыков[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Feinde, die durch einen [secondary]kritischen Treffer[/secondary] getötet werden, explodieren und verursachen [secondary]Skill-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Reload Speed[/secondary] and [secondary]Accuracy[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]装填速度[/secondary]和[secondary]精准度[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Скорость перезарядки[/secondary] и [secondary]точность[/secondary] [primary]искателя Хранилища[/primary] повышаются.
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Nachladegeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und [secondary]Zielgenauigkeit[/secondary].

desc.EN: During [secondary]Fight For Your Life[/secondary] the [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] can now [secondary]Aim[/secondary] down sights and does not suffer [secondary]Gun Accuracy[/secondary] penalties.
desc.ZH: 进入[secondary]殊死一搏[/secondary]状态时，[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]可开镜[secondary]瞄准[/secondary]，且[secondary]枪械精准度[/secondary]不会降低。
desc.RU: В [secondary]режиме борьбы за жизнь[/secondary] у [primary]искателя Хранилища[/primary] нет штрафа [secondary]точности[/secondary] при стрельбе [secondary]без прицеливания[/secondary].
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] kann die [secondary]Zielvorrichtung[/secondary] im [secondary]Kämpfe um dein Leben-Modus[/secondary] nun ohne [secondary]Waffen-Präzisionsstrafe[/secondary] verwenden.

desc.EN: While [secondary]Aiming[/secondary], the [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] and [secondary]Critical Hit Damage[/secondary] per second. Bonuses are lost after 2 seconds of not [secondary]Aiming[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]瞄准[/secondary]时每秒提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]和[secondary]暴击伤害[/secondary]。停止[secondary]瞄准[/secondary]超过2秒将失去加成。
desc.RU: За каждую секунду [secondary]прицеливания[/secondary] у [primary]искателя Хранилища[/primary] повышается [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary] и [secondary]критический урон[/secondary]. Бонусы обнуляются через 2 с. вне режима [secondary]прицеливания[/secondary].
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält beim [secondary]Zielen[/secondary] mit jeder Sekunde erhöhten [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary] und [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden[/secondary]. Diese Boni gehen verloren, wenn du 2 Sekunden lang nicht zielst.

desc.EN: [secondary]Kill Skill.[/secondary] Excess [secondary]Damage[/secondary] will be [secondary]Stored[/secondary] and added to your next [secondary]Gun Shot[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]杀戮技能。[/secondary]多余[secondary]伤害[/secondary]将被[secondary]存储[/secondary]并添加至下一次[secondary]射击[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Навык убийства.[/secondary] Избыточный [secondary]урон[/secondary] будет [secondary]копиться[/secondary] и добавится к следующему [secondary]выстрелу[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Kill-Skill.[/secondary] Überschüssiger [secondary]Schaden[/secondary] wird [secondary]gespeichert[/secondary] und deinem nächsten [secondary]Schuss[/secondary] hinzugefügt.

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Action Skill Cooldown Rate[/secondary] and multiplied [secondary]Action Skill Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]主动技能冷却速率[/secondary]，并以倍率提升[secondary]主动技能伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Искатель Хранилища[/primary] получает пониженное [secondary]время восстановления активного навыка[/secondary] и множитель к [secondary]урону от активных навыков[/secondary].

desc.EN: Reduce [secondary]Action Skill Cooldown[/secondary] whenever a [secondary]Repkit[/secondary] is activated.

desc.RU: [secondary]Перезарядка активного навыка[/secondary] ускоряется при активации [secondary]ремкомплекта[/secondary].
desc.DE: Die [secondary]Action-Skill-Abklingzeit[/secondary] wird mit jedem Einsatz eines [secondary]Reparaturkits[/secondary] reduziert.

desc.EN: [secondary]Action Skill Damage[/secondary] now benefits from increases to [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]加成将提升[secondary]主动技能伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от активного навыка[/secondary] теперь растет при повышении [secondary]урона от стрельбы[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Action-Skill-Schaden[/secondary] profitiert nun von erhöhtem [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Action Skills[/secondary] gain a chance to [secondary]Critically Hit[/secondary] enemies, and also gain increased [secondary]Action Skill Critical Hit Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]主动技能[/secondary]有几率[secondary]暴击[/secondary]敌人，并提升[secondary]主动技能暴击伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Активный навык[/secondary] дает шанс [secondary]критического попадания[/secondary] по врагу. Повышается [secondary]критический урон от активного навыка[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Action-Skills[/secondary] erhalten eine Chance, Feinde [secondary]kritisch zu treffen[/secondary], und erhöhten [secondary]kritischen Trefferschaden für Action-Skills[/secondary].

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] gains increased [secondary]Movement Speed[/secondary] and multiplied [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: 提升[primary]秘藏猎人[/primary]的[secondary]移动速度[/secondary]，并以倍率提升[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [primary]Искатель Хранилища[/primary] получает повышенную [secondary]скорость перемещения[/secondary] и множитель к [secondary]урону в ближнем бою[/secondary].
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] erhält erhöhte [secondary]Bewegungsgeschwindigkeit[/secondary] und multiplizierten [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: [secondary]Melee Damage[/secondary] now benefits from increases to [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary].
desc.ZH: [secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]加成将提升[secondary]近战伤害[/secondary]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон в ближнем бою[/secondary] теперь растет при повышении [secondary]урона от стрельбы[/secondary].
desc.DE: [secondary]Nahkampfschaden[/secondary] profitiert nun von erhöhtem [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary].

desc.EN: The [primary]Vault Hunter[/primary] can now [secondary]Hipfire[/secondary] while [secondary]Sprinting[/secondary], and gain [secondary]Gun Damage[/secondary] the faster they move.
desc.ZH: [primary]秘藏猎人[/primary][secondary]冲刺[/secondary]时可进行[secondary]腰射[/secondary]，移动速度越快，[secondary]枪械伤害[/secondary]加成越高。
desc.RU: Теперь [primary]искатель Хранилища[/primary] может [secondary]стрелять навскидку[/secondary] во время [secondary]бега[/secondary]. Чем быстрее двигается персонаж, тем больше [secondary]урон от стрельбы[/secondary].
desc.DE: Der [primary]Kammer-Jäger[/primary] kann nun beim [secondary]Sprinten[/secondary] [secondary]aus der Hüfte feuern[/secondary] und erhält zusätzlichen [secondary]Schusswaffen-Schaden[/secondary], je schneller er sich bewegt.

desc.EN: [secondary]Gun, Action Skill,[/secondary] and [secondary]Ordnance Damage[/secondary] is [secondary]Stored[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Melee Attacks[/secondary] and [secondary]Slam[/secondary] deal [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]Bonus[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]Kinetic Melee Damage[/kinetic] based on [secondary]Stored Damage[/secondary], and [secondary]consume[/secondary] it.
desc.ZH: [secondary]储存[/secondary][secondary]枪械、主动技能[/secondary]和[secondary]炮械伤害[/secondary]。[newline][newline][secondary]近战攻击[/secondary]和[secondary]猛击[/secondary]将[secondary]消耗[/secondary][secondary]储存的伤害[/secondary]，并根据储存伤害数值造成[nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]加成[/kinetic][/nowrap][kinetic]动能近战伤害[/kinetic]。
desc.RU: [secondary]Урон от стрельбы, активных навыков[/secondary] и [secondary][/secondary] снарядов [secondary]накапливается[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Атаки в ближнем бою[/secondary] и [secondary]удары по земле[/secondary] наносят [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]дополнительный[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]кинетический урон в ближнем бою[/kinetic]. Количество зависит от [secondary]накопленного урона[/secondary] и [secondary]тратит[/secondary] его.
desc.DE: [secondary]Schusswaffen-, Action-Skill-[/secondary] und [secondary]Kampfmittel-Schaden[/secondary] wird [secondary]gespeichert[/secondary].[newline][newline][secondary]Nahkampfangriffe[/secondary] und [secondary]Schmettern[/secondary] verursachen [nowrap][kinetic_icon][kinetic]zusätzlichen[/kinetic][/nowrap] [kinetic]kinetischen Nahkampfschaden[/kinetic] basierend auf dem [secondary]gespeicherten Schaden[/secondary] und [secondary]verbrauchen[/secondary] diesen.
